name: chrome-extension-monorepo-template-setup
description: Initial setup for the Chrome extension monorepo template. The shared setup-guard config strips the one-time gate; this config deletes setup/ afterwards, once clean-readme has read its template from there.

tasks.name: Update CONTRIBUTING.md
tasks.description: Update contributing guidelines with project info

tasks.name: Delete setup folder
tasks.description: Remove the guard, this config and its templates -- placed after clean-readme, which reads its template from setup/templates

tasks.name: Install dependencies
tasks.description: Run last, after the gate is gone, so the removed postinstall guard is not re-triggered
